description: Synthetic observation-noise scales for structural Fisher-geometry tests of the two-layer energy-balance state. These values define a reproducible identifiability control and are not calibrated instrument, reanalysis, or observational uncertainties.

surface_temperature.noise_model: independent Gaussian with state-independent standard deviation

toa_imbalance.noise_model: independent Gaussian with state-independent standard deviation

ocean_heat_uptake.noise_model: independent Gaussian with state-independent standard deviation

provenance.interpretation: noise magnitudes are chosen only to expose rank, complementarity, and precision-weighting semantics; changing them defines a different observation-control experiment rather than a statement about real observing-system accuracy
